request.deadline: Events stated as July 28-31, 2026 in Las Vegas, with Dev Gov Day on July 28, 2026 at ARIA Las Vegas.
deliverables: Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 main stage and livestream
free General Admission access for the Cardano community
complimentary booth space for selected Cardano ecosystem startup projects
five Cardano-focused main stage panelist positions
tier-1 media coverage for Cardano announcements
travel and lodging support for 20 Cardano ecosystem contributors or volunteers
20% of all VIP ticket sales returned to the Cardano Treasury
Dev Gov Day 2027 venue deposit and legal, admin, audit, fee, slippage, processing, and tax withholding allocations
request.what: Rare Network requests Cardano treasury funding for Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026.

claims.claim: Rare Network states that the requested ₳2,750,000 is based on a $0.24 ADA valuation for a $660,000 budget covering two Cardano sponsorship packages.
The proposal says Rare Network will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with current VIP retail value stated as $900 per ticket.

The proposal provides a cost breakdown allocating ₳1,166,666.67 to Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, ₳833,333.33 to Rare Evo 2026 title sponsorship, and ₳750,000 to Intersect, audit, fees, tax withholdings, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.
Rare Network states that Rare Evo 2026 will occur regardless of treasury funding, but treasury funding would expand Cardano presence, accessibility, participation, and industry outreach.

The proposal asserts Rare Evo 2025 had 2,500 attendees, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social media impressions, 40+ Cardano projects represented, and 50+ enterprise participants.

The proposal states the first Cardano Dev Gov Day in 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and included a Charles Hoskinson keynote, governance discussions, technical education, workshops, and community-building activities.
The document links to videos, a Dev Gov Day report, a livestream post, and other supporting material for prior Rare Evo and Dev Gov Day activity.

The proposal states selected Cardano projects and individuals will use open application forms for speaking opportunities, booth space, volunteer participation, and travel or lodging assistance, with selections prioritizing ecosystem contribution and in-person value creation.

The proposal says sponsorship allocation may change if another sponsor purchases the mainstage or livestream package before the vote passes, in which case Cardano would receive a sponsorship of equal impact or dollar value.

The proposal claims alignment with governance, community and ecosystem growth, and ecosystem sustainability pillars by increasing governance participation, onboarding, education, industry engagement, and use of existing event infrastructure.

summary: The document requests ₳2.75 million for Cardano sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 and Dev Gov Day 2026, presenting prior event metrics, sponsorship deliverables, a budget table, access benefits, application-based allocation of some benefits, and an asserted treasury return from VIP ticket sales.
